title: Shuffle String
summary: Given a string and an integer array of the same length, rearrange the string according to the positions specified in the array.
statement: Given a string and an integer array of the same length, rearrange the string according to the positions specified in the array. Return the rearranged string.
constraints: indices is a permutation of positions 0 through len(s)-1.
Character s[i] must move to position indices[i].
hints: Allocate an output slot for every character.
For each source index i, place s[i] into output[indices[i]].
Because indices is a permutation, every output position is filled exactly once with its specified source.
editorial: Because indices is a permutation, every output position is filled exactly once with its specified source.

tests.explanation: Placing every character at its listed destination spells leetcode.
The identity permutation leaves abc unchanged.
